{{Quote|Perhaps you are here to sell something. Something that  might be a little hard to sell elsewhere. Many people come here looking for Lady V's help in moving things that they otherwise cannot. If it something that the Lady deals with she might be willing to take it off of your hands.|Sneg the Hand, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StH" />}}
'''Sneg''', nicknamed '''Sneg the Hand''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked as a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] in [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian's]] ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The Devaronian used to buy any kind of second-hand weapons for the use of the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian gang]] from travelers visiting the ''Lucky Despot''.<ref name="SWG:StH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Lady Valarian had a special interest in [[Melee weapon/Legends|hand-to-hand weapons]] and tasked Sneg the Hand to provide her with such weapons.<ref name="SWG:StH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sneg the Hand was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:StH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sneg was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 7 Notes for 17 March 04|Publish 7]],"<ref name="SWG:StH" /> on [[March 17]], [[2004]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 7: Droid Invasion">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=61441|text=Publish 7: Droid Invasion}}</ref>
